Introduction to FBR IRIS Portal Registration

FBR IRIS portal registration is mandatory for all taxpayers in Pakistan. As an unregistered person, registering with the Federal Board of Revenue (FBR) IRIS portal can be a daunting task. The FBR has introduced the IRIS portal to facilitate taxpayers in filing their tax returns and paying taxes online.

How to Register for FBR IRIS Portal

To register for the FBR IRIS portal, you need to follow these steps:

  1. Visit the FBR IRIS portal website at iris.fbr.gov.pk and click on the 'New Registration' button.
  2. Fill in the required information, including your name, CNIC number, and mobile number.
  3. Create a username and password for your account.
  4. Verify your account through the verification email sent by the FBR.
  5. Log in to your account and fill in the required tax information.

Key Takeaway: Registering for the FBR IRIS portal is a straightforward process.

Common Mistakes to Avoid

Here are some common mistakes to avoid when registering for the FBR IRIS portal:

  • Incorrect information: Make sure you fill in the correct information, including your name, CNIC number, and mobile number.
  • Incomplete documents: Make sure you have all the required documents, including your CNIC, business registration certificate, and tax returns.
  • Invalid username and password: Make sure you create a valid username and password for your account.

Deeper Insight into FBR IRIS Portal

The FBR IRIS portal uses API technology to facilitate taxpayers in filing their tax returns and paying taxes online. The API technology allows taxpayers to integrate their accounting systems with the FBR IRIS portal, making it easier to file tax returns and pay taxes.

Benefits of FBR IRIS Portal Registration

Here are some benefits of registering for the FBR IRIS portal:

  • Easy tax filing: Registering for the FBR IRIS portal makes it easy to file tax returns and pay taxes online.
  • Reduced penalties: Registering for the FBR IRIS portal can help reduce penalties up to PKR 100,000.
  • Improved compliance: Registering for the FBR IRIS portal can help improve compliance with tax laws and regulations.
